title: Hath0r AWS EKS Fargate Profile Specification Schema
description: Defines the AWS EKS Fargate Profile parameters, subnet routing, pod execution IAM roles, and namespace/label selectors.

fargate_profile_name.description: Unique identifier of the Fargate Profile within the EKS cluster.

cluster_name.description: Name of the AWS EKS cluster.

pod_execution_role_arn.description: IAM Role granting kubelet permissions to pull private images from ECR and configure VPC networking.

subnets.description: List of private VPC subnets where Fargate MicroVMs will be provisioned.

selectors.description: Namespace and label selectors determining which Kubernetes pods schedule onto AWS Fargate.
